news.title: Jalen Green scores 25 and Devin Booker adds 22 to help the Suns top the Pelicans 123-119 in OT
news.text: — Jalen Green scored 25 points, Devin Booker added 22, and the Phoenix Suns defeated the New Orleans Pelicans, 123-119 in overtime on Monday night.

news.title: Victor Wembanyama has 50 points, 19 rebounds on dominant night as Spurs roll past Pelicans, 114-91
news.text: — Victor Wembanyama had 50 points, with 32 coming in the first half, along with 19 rebounds, five blocks and four steals and the San Antonio Spurs rolled to a 114-91 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans on Saturday.

news.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 40 as Thunder beat Pelicans 126-120 in NBA Cup
news.text: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40 points and the Oklahoma City Thunder rallied in the fourth quarter for a 126-120 win over the New Orleans Pelicans on Friday night to improve to 2-1 in NBA Cup play.

news.title: John Collins scores 20 points and Pistons hit 17 3s in 122-109 win over Pelicans
news.text: — John Collins hit four 3-pointers and scored 20 points to lead seven Detroit players in double figures as the Pistons beat the New Orleans Pelicans 122-109 on Wednesday night.

news.title: Fears' first triple-double leads the Pelicans past the Warriors 115-94
news.text: — Jeremiah Fears had 19 points, 10 assists and 10 rebounds for his first career triple-double, and the New Orleans Pelicans snapped a six-game losing streak with a 115-94 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Monday night.

news.title: Jokic, Murray help Nuggets hand Pelicans a sixth straight loss
news.text: — Nikola Jokic had 26 points, eight rebounds and 10 assists, Jamal Murray added 23 points, seven rebounds and nine assists, and the Denver Nuggets outlasted the New Orleans Pelicans 116-108 on Saturday night.

news.title: Grizzlies have record-tying 10 double-figure scorers in 142-111 romp over Pelicans in NBA Cup play
news.text: — Jerami Grant scored 22 points, including seven points on an extended possession in the first half, and the Memphis Grizzlies routed the New Orleans Pelicans 142-111 in NBA Cup group play Friday night.

news.title: Dejounte Murray wants trade from Pelicans; both sides working on resolution
news.text: Pelicans guard Dejounte Murray wants a trade from the franchise, and his agent, Klutch Sports CEO Rich Paul, and team officials have started working on a resolution.

news.title: Zion Williamson calls out Pelicans for another 'unacceptable' blowout loss
news.text: Zion Williamson called for accountability after the Pelicans lost their fourth straight game, saying the team needed to look itself in the mirror.

news.title: Egor Demin scores 22 in his return as the Nets rout the Pelicans 145-111
news.text: — Egor Demin returned from a six-game injury absence to score 22 points, Michael Porter Jr. also scored 22, and the Brooklyn Nets beat New Orleans 145-111 on Wednesday night, handing the Pelicans their fourth consecutive loss.
